description:
Get one Google ad (creative): its variants, topic, first/last shown dates and, per
        region, the dates and the impressions range Google publishes.

        Cost: 1 credit.

        Args:
            creative_id: Creative ID (CR..., the `id` returned by search_google_ads).
            advertiser_id: Advertiser ID (AR...) of that creative.
name: get_google_ad
title: Get a Google ad
